name: How much time does moving kitchen plumbing and appliances add to a remodel?

mainEntity.name: How much time does moving kitchen plumbing and appliances add to a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Moving major appliances or the primary sink typically adds between one and three weeks to your kitchen remodel schedule. Relocating these fixtures requires opening drywall or subfloors to extend supply lines, drain lines, gas tubing, or 240-volt electrical circuits. The work also requires coordination with licensed trade rough-ins and city inspections before walls can be closed. If your home has a finished basement or is built on a concrete slab, running new drain lines requires additional demolition and repair time compared to an open crawlspace.
acceptedAnswer.description: Moving sinks or major appliances usually adds one to three weeks to account for utility line rerouting, rough-in work, and required inspections.
